checks.detail: Protocol2 requires its explicit accepted status/scope and fixed second unsubmitted failure/diagnostic, D101 gate, target and typed frontier. Consumer reconstructs the full process inventory and all 90 response identities, verifies every frozen SHA and exactly partitions the 475 historical PIDs into eligible and hard-deny sets.

checks.detail: Original START/complete STOP, invocation/request/response hashes, sidecars, parent chain, actual bridge and known UTC births are revalidated. Every eligible historical occurrence must have its matching complete proof in that invocation. For each eligible PID, the policy accumulates the maximum original STOP time across all old births using nanosecond-safe comparison.

checks.check: Fresh current birth instead of a changing whitelist
checks.detail: Without review, any present historical PID still rejects. Protocol1 remains exact-current-identity. Protocol2 samples the complete reconstructed census including response-only unknown bridge15144; each present PID must be eligible, not hard-denied, and have a known authoritative OS birth strictly later than its maximum old STOP. Name/parent/executable remain diagnostics rather than a reuse allowlist.

Only protocol2 permits distinct child instances of the same PID, keyed by PID and normalized UTC OS birth. Exact duplicates and equivalent timestamps with different fractional precision reject. A child cannot use the root PID. Every referenced parent PID and actual bridge PID must have exactly one known birth; ambiguous parents/bridge reject without time-based guessing.

Both boundaries freshly validate full historical evidence, all ledgers and current birth rules. Only protocol2 allows native_current_matches to differ between boundaries. Ledger inventory/state, complete historical hashes, PID census, immutable review binding and policy remain equal. Default/protocol1 retain full strict equality.

resolved_finding.problem: The original protocol2 draft keyed children by PID alone and rejected a real complete tree containing two different known OS instances of the same leaf PID; 74 mocked tests passed while real proof consumption failed.
resolved_finding.resolution: Final consumer distinguishes normalized PID+birth instances only for protocol2 while requiring unique parent/bridge identities. Original evidence is unchanged, seven leaf-specific cases were added, and root's actual full historical consumer now passes.
